change.summary: Stop the Modefite GlobalPos reflection storm and keep optional distant-render services within the 16 GB Test workstation memory boundary.

modifiers.before: Every JEI item render can repeat failed reflective GlobalPos field lookup and print a stack trace.
modifiers.after: An exact optional Mixin returns GlobalPos record accessors directly, while the curated toggle no longer renders an ItemStack.

modifiers.before: Voxy rendering disabled while Voxy ingestion and VSS LOD receipt remain active.
modifiers.after: Disabled rendering also disables ingestion and LOD receipt. Enabled rendering uses 32 chunks, two Voxy service threads, no prediction, and no Xaero bridge.
Sample once per 10 seconds in-world and log only transitions across 512 MiB, 1 GiB, and 2 GiB.
-Xms2G -Xmx5G -Xss1M for the local 16 GB Test workstation only

cause.owner: JEMCompat client compatibility and local Test runtime configuration

rationale.purpose: Prevent the confirmed log storm and native-memory exhaustion without removing required resource-pack support or inventing a second renderer lifecycle.
rationale.decision_source: Approved 2026-11-22 catalog, fishing, boss, weather, and stability one-shot plan
rationale.user_requested: Repair the confirmed crash causes while preserving all prior client and server work.
rationale.codex_choices: Reuse Modefite's public method boundary and the installed Voxy/Embeddium native teardown paths. Add bounded threshold diagnostics instead of per-sample logging.

introduced.summary: Implement the approved one-shot stability phase.

history.summary: Replace repeated Modefite reflection, align optional distant-render settings, bound diagnostics, and lower the local Test server heap.

relations: JEI overlay render -> Modefite item definition render -> GlobalPos access
Voxy render state -> Voxy ingestion and VSS receipt
local server heap plus client heap -> native allocation headroom
notes: Modefite remains installed because current resource packs use its item-definition support.
Native Voxy world-change and resource-reload teardown remains the lifecycle owner.
unresolved: Runtime log and native allocation acceptance requires a later explicitly authorized Test client launch.
